newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Placer to bid for Highlands - papers.
newsitem.headline: Placer to bid for Highlands - papers.

text.p: Gold miner Placer Pacific Ltd or its Canadian parent Placer Dome Inc are expected to launch a A$450 million to A$480 million takeover bid for miner Highlands Gold Ltd, The Australian Financial Review and The Australian newspapers reported on Thursday.
The bid was widely speculated late on Wednesday after about 20 percent of Highland's shares were traded after the close, with Placer Pacific seen the likely buyer, the papers said.
"Placer Pacific is understood to be planning a full bid for Highlands pitched at about 80 cents a share," the Financial Review said.
"A A$480 million takeover offer at 85 cents a share for Papua New Guinea-based Highlands Gold Ltd is expected to be announced today," The Australian newspaper said.
Highland's shares closed up three cents at 58 cents on Wednesday. The bulk of the 20 percent stake crossed late on Wednesday By Macquarie Equities traded at 75 cents.
"It is believed the broker was buying additional stock in London overnight to seek to accumulate up to 33 percent, the PNG takeover law threshold," The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper said.
Highlands' major asset is its 25 percent stake in the one million ounce a year Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea (PNG).
Placer Pacific, which is 75 percent owned by Vancouver-based Placer Dome Inc, also owns 25 percent of Porgera and is the mine's manager.

A senior broker, the head of an institutional dealing desk, told Reuters earlier on Wednesday that Placer was actively seeking Highlands' shares on-market through Macquarie Equities with an order book of up to 160 million shares.
Another market source told Reuters that Placer was the most likely buyer as the company has previously expressed a desire to simplify the complex owneship at Porgera.
The remaining 50 percent of Porgera is split equally between Goldfields Ltd and the recently floated holding company for the PNG government's resource assets, Orogen Minerals Ltd.
